text:
zach_sales: Quick presales ask from MapleTrust: need Canada-only for a 4-week POC. Data+logs must stay in ca-central-1. BYOK with customer HSM required. Also need subprocessor names that could see metadata. What's our lowest-risk deployment and cost delta vs hosted?

emma_sre: Hosted API can't promise CA-only because control plane metrics may route. Recommend Private or Dedicated with tenant pinning. For POC we can do Dedicated pinned to ca-central-1 and disable EU regions. If they absolutely forbid failover, Private single-region is safest.

emma_sre: routing policy example:
```
tenant_pin: ca-central-1
allowed_regions: [ca-central-1]
deny_regions: [all eu_* regions]
failover: []  # no failover allowed
```

ria_security: We can share a redacted subprocessor matrix (region-filtered) before NDA: cloud provider (GCP ca-central-1), logging stack (configurable in-region), monitoring vendor (can be restricted). Full list requires NDA. BYOK/HSM onboarding typically 10-15 business days for attestations.

leo_legal: We can do contractual "no EU egress" language but need to agree on exceptions (patch downloads, emergency indicators). Ask their legal for acceptable exceptions. NDA first for detailed subproc.

netops: For peering we need their CIDR, ASN, expected b/w. Interconnect lead time ~5-10 business days depending on provider. Note: single-region Private removes cross-region egress charges but has infra cost.

emma_sre: Ballpark pricing for 4-week POC: Dedicated pinned trial ~"$7k" for the month (discounted) + HSM add-on ~$3k/mo + one-time peering ~$1k. Private single-region short-term package ~"$12k" + onboarding. I'll follow up with a formal quote.

infra-bot: infra-bot: Created ticket PRESALES-2140 -> ca-poC-byo-hsm.

zach_sales: Thanks all. I'll send NDA and their security contact. Please DM the quote and a short ops checklist I can include in the SOW. :thumbsup:
